card.headline: a win for *aek*, a first loss for keravnos.
card.deck: Petrolina AEK beat Tartu in Larnaca. Keravnos fell to King Szczecin in Nicosia.

rows.note: Myles Tate 26 points · AEK 2-1 in Group E
Jaye Crockett 20 points · Keravnos 2-1 in Group D

card.footnote: Next: both on the road on Tuesday 27 October.

caption:
A win and a defeat for the two Cypriot clubs in the FIBA Europe Cup on Wednesday night. 🏀

Petrolina AEK beat Tartu Ülikool Maks & Moorits 99-93 at the Kition Athletic Center in Larnaca. Myles Tate led them with 26 points, and AEK are 2-1 in Group E.

Keravnos lost 65-78 to King Szczecin at the Costas Papaellinas Arena in Nicosia, their first defeat after two wins. Jaye Crockett scored 20, and they are 2-1 in Group D.

Both are on the road on Tuesday: AEK at MZT Skopje, Keravnos at BC Vienna. Who stood out for you? 🇨🇾

Source: FIBA
